author: TeIq
content:
CLOSED as DOCUMENTED-ARCHITECTURAL. Hardware-token signing depends on a real PKCS#11 token (YubiKey PIV or YubiHSM) + softhsm2 for CI fixture testing. The issue body's spec (HwTokenSigningKey impl + signature_status schema + sign-pending CLI + polaris-signer daemon + FIDO2 PRF + rotation + audit) is the implementation guide for an operator with hardware-token access who picks this up. Design captured in .design/m5/49-hardware-token-signing.md.

PR 1 (#164 — SigningError::WouldBlock + PhysicalPresenceTimeout + TokenDisconnected variants) and PR 3 (#166 — labels.signature_status + signed_at + pending_label_queue view migration 0029) shipped in-session as the additive foundation.
